item.title: NASA’s Swift Mission Ends, Leaves Behind Scientific Bonanza
item.description: NASA’s Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory has ended its science mission now that the spacecraft is orbiting less than 171 miles (275 kilometers) above Earth’s surface. The greater atmospheric drag at this height prevents the satellite’s telescopes from steadily gazing at their astronomical targets. Swift conducted its final observation on Oct. 20. item.title: Inside Extramural at the National Institute on Deafness and Other Communication Disorders (NIDCD)
item.description: Every day, tens of millions of Americans navigate the world with a communication disorder—such as an isolating hearing loss, a faltering voice, a fading sense of taste or smell. Our mission at NIDCD is to change that reality through partnerships with the research community.

item.title: Help NIH Rethink the Administrative Work Behind Proposing and Conducting Research
item.description: We know the grants process takes time, effort, and resources for you, your organization, and for NIH. We have been undertaking many efforts to identify and minimize associated burdens, while not inadvertently harming the integrity of the supported research.
